label: <DEL> step when the first token to recall is v/a/j/d
explanation: 72% of activation mass is at the delimiter step (8.5x lift; 66% of activations), when the model is about to output original token 0. Whether it fires there, and how strongly, depends mostly on which token it will output: first token v (13.5x lift, 31% of mass, and all top examples begin v v...), then a, j, d. Sequences with fewer digits and shorter L fire a bit more. The other ~25% of mass is in the original phase at t=2..9, mostly on the first occurrence of g, o or x, and it is also stronger in sequences that begin with v. It is almost silent in the copy phase (3.5% of mass) and never fires at t=0. Delimiter-only gets mass recall 0.72 but precision 0.085. Restricting to first_tok in {v,a,j,d} gives F1 about 0.37 on dev. Whether it fires is graded and depends on context beyond these variables.
